verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a Private Cloud option: a dedicated, isolated, managed private instance on AWS or Azure, chosen for data-residency needs. Customers can also pick among Azure's 60+ regions to store customer data. Custom database connections to an external user store appear only in a gradual-migration (import mode) context, and nothing documents a self-managed or self-hosted deployment. missing for 10: self-managed/self-hosted deployment option, documented ongoing use of your own database as the system of record (beyond migration), independent corroboration of the Private Cloud isolation claims.
